svg.aria-label: SmartManipulator-X: a Robot PC running ROS 2 sends DYNAMIXEL packets over USB to a SmartFusion2 controller, which answers as virtual DYNAMIXEL servos and drives the stepper motors of a BCN3D Moveo arm through six TMC5160 drivers
